author: KEXP
description: Led by pianist Gauthier Toux, French band Photons showcase their passion for acoustic jazz, house, ambient, and techno in our latest Live on KEXP session from Trans Musicales.
title: Photons performs "PREMIÈRES LUEURS" and more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

description:
